XVI. Quintò, Ab Ecclesia fallibilitate. Quia quælibet Ecclesia parti-
cularis visibilis exitialiter errare potest tam in fide, quàm in moribus, ut
postea probabitur. Ergo potest etiam obscurari & deficere; tales enim er-
rores sunt causæ proximæ corrumpentes & destruentes Ecclesiam. Aliàs
nihil opus fuisset Christum tam sollicitè monere fideles, ut sibi cave-
rent à Pseudo-Christis & Pseudo-Prophetis, ut facit Matth. 24. 24. Nec
Johannes explorationem spirituum Christianis debuisset tanto cum stu-
dio præcipere 1. Joann. 4. 1. 2. si in omnibus ætatibus Ecclesia vera de-
buit illustris esse & conspicua. Satis fuisset eos uno verbo monere, ut nun-
quam à tali Ecclesiæ communione discederent.

page.notes: Underlined in the original: "Quæ nunc Ecclesia Christum" (paragraph 3) and "Quando" (paragraph 3). The page is shaded and the scan is blurred. Doubtful readings: "Pelis" (possibly another word), "Thes." (could be "Thess."), the Roman numeral in the top margin "QVÆSTIO", and the catchword "sæ-" at bottom right, which repeats the hyphenated line end. Printed spelling "Athanas." has a long s rendered as plain s; "hîc" and "Joann." are kept as printed. Some citation lines are set in roman type and others in italic; the choice is based on the visible slant.
